Payload.Name: Closed-Loop Life Support
Payload.Description: Better air and water recycling, heat recovery and lighting. Multiplies a ship's life support per crew aboard (1 kW at level 0) and the hostile-world term of a sealed colony's life support: x1 at level 0, x0.85 a level, to about x0.27 at level 8. Applies at once to every ship and colony.

Payload.Name: Habitat Gravity Tolerance
Payload.Description: Widens the infrastructure window on the prefab and the site. It does not move the prefab track. Level 0 is 1.962 m/s² wide. Level 3 is about 6.7 m/s², enough to cover Earth and Mars in one window. Level 6 is about 11.4 m/s², enough to cover Luna through Earth.

Payload.Name: Low-Gravity Habitat Engineering
Payload.Description: Opens track below the prefab window so that window can slide toward low-gravity bodies. It does not widen the window. The five levels reach 0 m/s².

Payload.Name: High-Gravity Habitat Engineering
Payload.Description: Opens track above the prefab window so that window can slide toward heavy worlds. It does not widen the window. The five levels reach about 100 m/s².

Payload.Name: Habitat Pressure Tolerance
Payload.Description: Widens the pressure window on the prefab and the site. It does not move the prefab track. Level 0 is 0.20 atm wide. Level 3 is 0.50 atm wide.

Payload.Name: Thin-Atmosphere Habitat Engineering
Payload.Description: Opens the floor of the prefab track toward vacuum. It does not widen the window. Level 1 reaches 0 atm.

Payload.Name: Dense-Atmosphere Habitat Engineering
Payload.Description: Opens the ceiling of the prefab track. It does not widen the window. The ceiling is capped at 10 atm, so a runaway-greenhouse atmosphere stays out of reach.

Payload.Name: Mining Production Efficiency
Payload.Description: Multiplies the kilograms per day of each mine and robo-miner. Level 0 is the installation's own rate. Each level adds 1.5 times that rate. Accessibility still scales each deposit: half at 0.5, one tenth at 0.1. The installations apply this same 1 + level * 1.5 expression.

Payload.Name: Advanced Battery Technology
Payload.Description: Utilizes advanced materials and manufacturing techniques to exponentially increase battery energy density, reaching a threefold increase at its peak.

Payload.Name: Alcubierre Miniaturization
Payload.Description: Research into shrinking a drive to fit smaller form factors

Payload.Name: Alcubierre Bubble Creation Cost
Payload.Description: By finding better ways to manipulate the warp bubble, we can make the drive more efficient

Payload.Name: Alcubierre Sustain Cost
Payload.Description: By finding better ways to manipulate the warp bubble, we can make the drive more efficient

Payload.Name: Alcubierre Gravitational Coupling
Payload.Description: A lower coupling eases the reactor draw of an uphill warp

Payload.Name: Alcubierre Bleed
Payload.Description: How much of drive speed a downhill warp may keep

Payload.Name: Alcubierre Collapse Efficency
Payload.Description: We can recover some of the energy put into creating the bubble when we collapse it in a controlled manner

Payload.Name: Rocket Engine Maximum Power
Payload.Description: Research to increase the upper limits of conventional rocket power

Payload.Name: Rocket Engine Minimum Power
Payload.Description: Research to find the lower limits of conventional rocket power

Payload.Name: Rocket Engine Maximum Size
Payload.Description: Research into better cooling allows larger engine sizes

Payload.Name: Rocket Engine Minimum Size
Payload.Description: Research into miniaturization allows smaller engine sizes

Payload.Name: Rocket Engine Exhaust Velocity
Payload.Description: Research into higher exhaust velocities for engines, making them more efficient

Payload.Name: Rocket Engine Fuel Consumption
Payload.Description: Research into better plumbing and pump layouts allows better fuel efficiency

Payload.Name: JumpPoint Stabilization
Payload.Description: A ship equipped with this module can Stabilise a JumpPoint

Payload.Name: JumpPoint Size Reduction
Payload.Description: Reduces the size of a component required for Jump Point Stabilisation

Payload.Name: JumpPoint Time Reduction
Payload.Description: Reduces the time it takes to stabilise a Jump Point

Payload.Name: High Explosives
Payload.Description: Better explosive compounds increase the Relative effectiveness factor

Payload.Name: HE Warheads
Payload.Description: High Explosive Warheads that produce a large amount of heat and pressure

Payload.Name: Fragmentation Warheads
Payload.Description: Warheads that produce a large amount of fragmentation

Payload.Name: Fission Warheads
Payload.Description: Warheads that produce massive amounts of Heat and pressure

Payload.Name: Laser Warheads
Payload.Description: Smart warheads that fire a high energy beam towards the target on detonation

Payload.Name: Trigger Tech
Payload.Description: Enables different warhead triggers for ordnance

Payload.Name: Guidance Tech
Payload.Description: Enables different guidance options ordnance

Payload.Name: Antenna Sensitivity
Payload.Description: Improvements to antennas to increase the ability to pick up smaller signals from background noise

Payload.Name: Antenna Efficiency
Payload.Description: Improvements to antennas increase the effective area of a sensor, allowing for greater sensitivity for a smaller size

Payload.Name: Antenna Bandwidth
Payload.Description: Improvements to antennas increase the max bandwidth of an antenna

Payload.Name: Modern Technology
Payload.Description: Unlocks all modern technologies needed for space flight and exploration

Payload.Name: Factory Maximum Size
Payload.Description: Research into the logistics and design of larger factories

Payload.Name: Shipyard Slip Maximum Size
Payload.Description: Research into the logistics and design of larger slips for shipyards

Payload.Name: Larger Academy Classes
Payload.Description: A naval academy can take a larger class

Payload.Name: Better Academy Instruction
Payload.Description: Graduates and command courses leave with a higher experience cap

Payload.Name: Academy Candidate Search
Payload.Description: A class can be drawn from a smaller colony

Payload.Name: Geological Surveyor
Payload.Description: Research into geological surveys of system bodies

Payload.Name: Asteroid Mining
Payload.Description: Research into mining asteroids from a ship

Payload.Name: Gravitational Surveyor
Payload.Description: Research into surveying gravitational anomalies

Payload.Name: Solar Panel Efficiency
Payload.Description: Improves the base absorption efficiency of solar panels

Payload.Name: Solar Panel Bandwidth
Payload.Description: Increases the maximum tunable bandwidth for solar panels

Payload.Name: Solar Panel Density
Payload.Description: Reduces the mass per square meter of solar panels

Payload.Name: Early Technology
Payload.Description: Starting gate for the Early Tech Start: opens the basic industrial, survey and propulsion research lines. Ships move by reaction drive only; nuclear power must be researched, and warp and jump-point technology after that.

Payload.Name: Nuclear Power
Payload.Description: Fission reactors, steam turbine reactors and RTGs. Leads on to directed energy and warp research.

Payload.Name: Directed Energy
Payload.Description: Lasers and the beam fire control that aims them.

Payload.Name: Alcubierre Warp Drive
Payload.Description: Warp drives, jump point survey and stabilisation, and the research lines that improve them. Nothing in this line is known at the start.

Payload.Name: Thermal Plant Efficiency
Payload.Description: Better boilers, turbines and heat recovery. The share of fuel heat a thermal plant, methalox turbine or fission plant turns into electricity: 33% at level 0, +3 points a level. Simple-cycle plants stop at 45% (fission plants always do); Combined Cycle lifts the cap to 60%. New plant designs pick up the level; built plants keep the efficiency they were designed with.

Payload.Name: Combined Cycle
Payload.Description: A steam cycle on the gas turbine's exhaust. Raises the thermal plant efficiency cap from 45% to 60% (methalox turbines to 55%). Opened by Thermal Plant Efficiency level 4, where simple-cycle plants reach the 45% cap.

Payload.Name: Fission Power Plant
Payload.Description: Grid-scale fission: a reactor and turbine hall for a colony. Unlocks the fission power plant. Needs Nuclear Power.

Payload.Name: Reactor Power Density
Payload.Description: Hotter cores and better fuel. Multiplies a ship reactor's heat per kg of fuel (and so its output and fuel burn): x1 at level 0, +0.25 a level. New reactor designs pick up the level.

Payload.Name: Reactor Power Conversion
Payload.Description: Brayton and Stirling conversion for ship reactors: the share of reactor heat turned into electricity, 30% at level 0, +1.5 points a level. The steam turbine reactor uses this value; its core runs hot enough that a 2 tonne plant still gives 15 kW at level 0.

Payload.Name: Grid Distribution
Payload.Description: Better transformers and lines. The share of generated power a colony grid delivers: 92% at level 0, +0.75 points a level, to 98%. Applies to every colony at once.

Payload.Name: Industrial Energy Efficiency
Payload.Description: Efficient motors, furnaces and heat recovery. Multiplies the build energy every industry point spends (refining, fabrication and assembly): x1 at level 0, -5% a level, to x0.6. Applies to running jobs at once; a design's listed build energy stays the level 0 figure.

Payload.Name: Construction Automation
Payload.Description: Assembly robots, powered tools and machine-guided fitting. Multiplies the crew a ship's construction bay needs: x1 at level 0, x0.85 a level, to about x0.27 at level 8. Applies to bays designed after the research; existing designs keep their crew.

Payload.Name: Fuel Cells
Payload.Description: Hydrogen and methane fuel cells: non-nuclear ship power from tank propellant. Unlocks the fuel cell generator (about 60 W/kg, half a kilogram of propellant per kWh).
